answer: Each identity bids in a sealed auction for a basalt terrace plot, its bid signed to a basalt anchor. Highest bid wins the terrace; losers burn, winner locks a 70-credit bond. One key, one plot: a second bid is void, its stake burns; rented bids fail since each bid binds one anchor serial. Seizing 1,000 plots means outbidding honest agents 1,000 times. First bid 38, kth 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, lock 70,000. Honest agents pay 38 once.
